newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa says concerned with violence in Kenya.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa says concerned with violence in Kenya.

text.p: South Africa said on Thursday it had summoned Kenya's charge d'affaires in Pretoria to discuss the violence in Nairobi this week.

The Department of Foreign Affairs said it was concerned with events in Kenya where at least nine people have been killed in clashes between police and protesters calling for constitutional changes ahead of elections later this year.
"The South African government views with serious concern the events which have taken place in Kenya this week...," the statement said.

"The Charge d'Affaires of the Kenyan High Commission in South Africa has been called in by the acting director general of the Department of Foreign Affairs to discuss the situation," the statement added.
The violence this week is the worst since unrest in 1991 which helped push President Daniel arap Moi to allow pluralist politics.
South Africa appealed to all parties in Kenya to "confine themselves to peaceful means to achieve their objectives".
